name: Dragonborn
description: Dragonborn resemble wingless, bipedal dragons. Their scales, horns, and coloration reflect a draconic ancestor whose magic shapes their breath and defenses.

grants.name: Draconic Ancestry
grants.description: Choose your dragon ancestor. Its damage type applies to your Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance.

grants.name: Breath Weapon
grants.description: When you take the Attack action, replace one attack with a 15-foot Cone or a 30-foot-by-5-foot Line (chosen each use). Creatures make a Dexterity save against DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + Proficiency Bonus, taking 1d10 ancestry damage on a failure or half on a success. Damage becomes 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 11, and 4d10 at level 17. Uses equal your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

grants.name: Damage Resistance
grants.description: You resist the damage type associated with your Draconic Ancestry.

grants.name: Darkvision
grants.description: You have Darkvision out to 60 feet.

grants.name: Draconic Flight
grants.description: At level 5, use a Bonus Action to sprout spectral wings for 10 minutes. They grant a Fly Speed equal to your Speed until retracted or you become Incapacitated. Once used, this trait refreshes on a Long Rest.
